name: Swiss Safety VR: Tunnel Construction
summary:
Immerse yourself in a new dimension of tunnel construction safety with this highly immersive VR training experience! Experience realistic work and hazard situations from tunnel and underground construction and encounter critical safety events that can occur during everyday work below ground. Sharpen your risk awareness and learn how proactive behavior and strict adherence to safety procedures can prevent accidents.
